title: Pro Shop Store Credit: dues-standing gate on the post-reinstatement reversal
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers the dues-standing condition on the post-reinstatement top-up reversal, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
The reversal amount is issued only while the member's separately-held club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance. Where that membership account's dues balance is greater than zero, none of the reversal amount is issued on this reinstatement.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose the calculated reversal amount for a member's recent top-up activity is 40.00 USD. If the member's club membership account shows no outstanding dues balance, the full 40.00 USD is issued. If instead that same membership account shows a dues balance greater than zero, nothing is issued on this reinstatement, regardless of how much top-up activity the one-month look-back window would otherwise have reversed.
